span.p:
If writes continue at 100K/sec during resync
→ backlog fills again immediately after resync
→ replica disconnects AGAIN
→ perpetual resync loop

span.p:
Fork increases primary memory (COW)
RDB transfer increases network load
Replica unavailable for reads

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 450px; text-align: center; width: 450px;

span.p:
Prevention: Set repl-backlog-size to 10% of maxmemory
at 24GB maxmemory → 2.4GB backlog → ~2 minutes of buffer
